content:
I just finished reading the instructions on how to transform my Core One to Core One + Gen 2, and I couldn't help but notice something important missing—where are the Gummy Bears? The instructions don’t mention them at all, and honestly, I’m not sure how you expect me to complete this task without them. Gummy Bears are practically essential for powering through these kinds of upgrades!

Could you let me know if there’s been an oversight, or if Gummy Bears are coming separately? I’d really appreciate some clarification before I get started.

replies.content: I too searched all the boxes and was crushed seeing zero bears. We have been Pavlovian conditioned to do these builds and upgrades not only for the reward of better printing but for the delicious gummy treats that we are given at the end of each chapter. I would even pay an extra $5 for the inclusion of bears if it came down to it, they are a vital part of anything with this many steps!

content: Is it not crucial to mention, that you need to adjust hardware settings to GT1.5, even maybe before all off the self test?

replies.content: Hello, thank you for the comment. We added a step that points you to change the printer type.

content: Um... What about the new top?

replies.content:
From: https://www.prusa3d.com/product/prusa-core-one-to-prusa-core-one-gen-2/

When you buy a brand new CORE One+ Gen2 3D printer (assembled or kit), it also features the same top cover as the CORE One L - the main difference is that this top cover is easier to remove. This top cover is not included in the upgrade kit, as it does not affect the performance of the machine and would increase the shipping costs. However, it can be purchased separately as a spare part - we'll add it to the spare part section in the upcoming days."
Sold separate as part in blog post
I just leave the rivets off the top.  I haven't noticed an issue yet.  Maybe someone will reply with a reason to keep the top riveted down.
